summary: Sixteen days to FreightWorks Expo (Nov 4). Maya declared Smart Slots the company-wide focus. Slot-scoring API waits on Nina's ranking (due Wednesday); Leila waits on Sam's final screens (today 3pm). Sync errors at 1.6% and Harbor's export limit are deferred. Third design partner is unsigned.

items.text: Maya decided Smart Slots is the priority for everyone until Expo on Nov 4; no side quests. Sync errors and the Harbor export limit are explicitly pushed to after Expo unless sync worsens.
Arjun cannot wire real recommendations into the scoring endpoint (passes on test data only) until Nina's ranking is delivered.
Nina committed to have the recommendation ranking up by Wednesday (Oct 21); ticket due Oct 27.
Leila is building the slot picker on placeholder screens and needs Sam's final designs to finish.
Sam promised final slot picker screens today by 3pm, then starts the Expo demo flow.
Coastal can go live once the API is stable. Valley is still sorting out data access on their side.
Coastal and Valley need endpoint docs before going live; Arjun created the ticket, due Oct 26.
Third design partner is not signed; Pinecrest Grocers is only in talks, and 3 live partners are needed by launch. Ticket due Oct 30.
Jordan asked Nina for Q3 usage numbers for Harbor's QBR deck; QBR is Thursday Oct 22.
Nina agreed to deliver Harbor's Q3 usage numbers by tomorrow (Oct 20).
Jordan is building the Harbor QBR deck for Thursday Oct 22.
Harbor renewal (Oct 30): order form sent Friday; Dana Whitfield said it should be routine.
Sync error rate was 1.6% on Oct 18, above the 1% target, mostly Ridgeline duplicates. Maya will revisit only if it gets worse. Ridgeline renews Nov 20.
Harbor asked again about the 5,000-row CSV export limit (Harbor's weekly export is about 7,000 rows); Jordan told them it is on the list. Deferred until after Expo.
Booth design review with Sam is Wednesday; Expo invites go out Friday.
Nina is on call this week (Oct 19), while also owning ranking work for Smart Slots.
